## Disposition

| Finding | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| R1 Failure-boundary class | **fixed** — launcher entry vs spawn, destination probe, promotion collision, containment, Git admission |
| R2 Environment lexical class | **fixed** — pure structural name/value rules at authorized locations |
| R3 Shipped failure wire contract | **fixed** — synchronized TS constants + schema pairs/locations/signals/exit/status/diagnostic |
| R4 Class regression proof | **fixed** — production-seam matrices; full suite green |

## Root cause

Specific failure labels were emitted without finite proved predicates; unexpected catches were laundered into occupancy/not-committed/not-escape or cause-less codes. Environment NUL/`=` defects were not rejected structurally. The shipped failure schema accepted arbitrary messages, locations, and signals.

## What changed (class owners)

**R1 — `bin/ak-docket-record.js`, `run.ts`, `paths.ts`, `admit.ts`, `errors.ts`**
- Launcher: missing package entry → `internal-error` + `launcher` diagnostic; actual spawn sync/async failure → `spawn-failed` + diagnostic. Child remains `not-spawned`. No message/stack/path/argv/env interpolation.
- Destination: `probeDestination` → occupied | absent | error. Occupancy only via successful `lstat`. Unexpected probe error → retained-cause `internal-error` at `destination`.
- Promotion: collision only from `isOccupiedRenameError` or successful occupancy observation; rename cause always retained with `promotion` diagnostic; otherwise `promotion-failed` with cause.
- Containment: `assertPathNotSymlinkEscape` / `assertScratchOutsideOrIgnored` — explicit ENOENT absence handling; other lstat/realpath failures fail closed with safe diagnostic; no silent continue; no lexical realpath fallback except documented ENOENT; `git check-ignore` exit 1 = not-ignored only; other statuses fail closed.
- Git admission: `isCommittedInContainingRepo` returns committed | not-committed | failed. Lawful negatives: rev-parse status 128 (no repo), ls-files --error-unmatch status 1 (untracked). Other failures → `admission-failed` with cause.

**R2 — `config.ts`**
- Override names: nonempty, no NUL, no `=`; values: no NUL; reject at `['execution','environment','overrides']` (no attacker key exposure).
- Unset names: same lexical rules at `['execution','environment','unset',index]`.
- Still pure structure, before metadata scan/state/admission/spawn. Inherited → unset → override and credential non-scan preserved.

**R3 — `errors.ts` + `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json`**
- Exported closed `RECORDER_PUBLIC_MESSAGES`, `RECORDER_SUPPORTED_SIGNALS`, `RECORDER_LOCATION_SEGMENTS`; stage includes `launcher`.
- Schema: code/message oneOf pairs; location max 4 + finite segment enum + bounded indices; non-config location null; internal-error requires diagnostic; signals enum; exit 0–255; child status nullability combinations.
- Runtime emission does not read schema.

**R4 — tests**
- Schema reject matrix; launcher missing-entry vs spawn-failed; destination occupied no-spawn; env NUL structural before spawn; existing cause/child/tee matrices retained.

## Audited owner/search boundaries

- Owners: launcher bin, `errors.ts`, `run.ts` (destination/promotion), `paths.ts` (containment), `admit.ts` (Git admission), `config.ts` (env structure), failure schema, focused failure/config tests + regenerated `dist/recorder/*`.
- Equivalent catches audited: launcher access/spawn; destination lstat; promotion rename; containment lstat/realpath/check-ignore; Git rev-parse/ls-files admission.
- Exceptions (documented expected negatives only): ENOENT absence; check-ignore exit 1; Git no-repo 128; ls-files untracked 1; native rename collision codes.

## Validation (current head)

- `npm run build:recorder` OK
- Focused recorder tests 89/89; full `npm test` 369/369
- `npm run typecheck` OK
- `npm pack --dry-run` OK
- `git diff --check` clean
- No probe residue; retained-snapshot/manual-cleanup and issue #13 scope untouched
